title: euphorbia corollata var. zinniiflora
intro: Euphorbia corollata var. zinniiflora, commonly known as Spurge or Zinnia-flowered Spurge, is a plant species in the Euphorbiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, such as skin problems and wounds, due to its antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Euphorbia corollata var. zinniiflora include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial effects, which may help alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which may contribute to its therapeutic properties.
